notes.title: Achievements & More Upgrades
notes.content:
The team at BluBee Games has implemented various major and minor updates into the Steam version of Iron Soul. While third person shooting, platforming and other gameplay elements are still intact, now you can get around earlier levels more easily. Some of problems with achievements and community features have also been fixed. 
Hopefully these improvements mean more Iron Warriors can finish the normal campaign and get to the Crazy Mode (AKA Campaign 1.5 in the main menu).

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Iron Soul
notes.content:
Iron Soul is Now Available on Steam and is 30% off to celebrate!

Discovery of a new Goldilocks planet has led to the creation of a new type of army: One that is made of metal and steel. One that can’t feel pain or fear. One that is said to be our only hope against a possible alien invasion. Sadly, even with all the technological advancements available to future governments, they are not fully in control of the machines… The bot-mageddon is coming and it will be up to one our brightest scientists to help us against the inevitable.
